req.title: Return 404 for unknown player ID
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID on GET /players/{playerId}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 404 when GET /players/{playerId} is called with a UUID that does not exist in the database. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case confirming a known UUID returns 200, (2) a negative case confirming an unknown UUID returns exactly 404, (3) a boundary case using a syntactically valid UUID that is one character away from a real one (all-zeros UUID, guaranteed absent), and (4) additional mutation-resilient cases that assert exact status codes and verify the 404 path is not accidentally suppressed. The pre-loaded fixture provides 26 known UUIDs; any UUID not in that set must yield 404. We also test that a malformed (non-UUID) path segment returns 422 (FastAPI validation), distinguishing it from the 404 path to kill mutations that conflate the two error codes. The violation fix: test[4] was kind=negative with heuristic=EP, which is invalid because EP is a positive-partition heuristic. It has been changed to heuristic=NEG to match its negative kind.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
trace: R-PLAYER-003: known player ID must return 200, not 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 'acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'

tests.name: test_get_player_404_response_for_every_absent_uuid_variant
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
None of the listed UUIDs exist in the fixture
actions: Send GET /players/{id} for three distinct absent UUIDs
trace: R-PLAYER-003: multiple absent UUIDs all return 404 — kills mutations that only handle one specific absent value
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_404_response_for_every_absent_uuid_variant():
    absent_ids = [
        'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff',
        '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111',
        'deadbeef-dead-beef-dead-beefdeadbeef',
    ]
    for uid in absent_ids:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{uid}')
        assert r.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 for {uid}, got {r.status_code}'
        assert r.status_code != 200
        assert r.status_code != 500

tests.name: test_known_id_returns_200_and_unknown_id_returns_404_in_sequence
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
UUID 5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d1 (last digit changed) does not exist
expected: First request returns HTTP 200 with correct player data
trace: R-PLAYER-003: BVA — UUID differing by one character from a real UUID must return 404; real UUID returns 200. Catches mutations that flip the not-found branch.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_known_id_returns_200_and_unknown_id_returns_404_in_sequence():
    known_id = '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'
    near_miss_id = '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d1'
    r_known = client.get(f'/players/{known_id}')
    assert r_known.status_code == 200
    body = r_known.json()
    assert body['id'] == known_id
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Franco'
    r_miss = client.get(f'/players/{near_miss_id}')
    assert r_miss.status_code == 404
    assert r_miss.status_code != 200
